summary: No high-severity or fatal numerical contradiction found. Six actionable issues: two medium and four low; C1 is the only potential claim-scope overstatement. The current contribution-led story is supported and needs precise presentation, not a new experiment or a longer limitations section.

issues.claim: Two tangent-residual ridge updates improve normalized alignment
evidence: paper/sections/method.tex, Eq. (5): the target is a norm-scaled negative cosine gradient.
paper/sections/method.tex, scale-equivariance paragraph: the finite fitted procedure does not guarantee finite-step cosine improvement.
src/arc2_global/model.py::_tangent2 fits projected row targets through one shared affine ridge map; its fitted row corrections need not be tangent.
The displayed results measure relevance-judged retrieval, not an independently reported normalized-alignment error reduction.
issues.why_it_matters: The contribution wording can be read as a mathematical improvement guarantee or as an additional measured endpoint, neither of which the paper establishes. The actual retrieval contribution is stronger and already supported.
issues.minimal_fix: Replace with: "Two tangent-residual ridge updates target prediction direction and improve development retrieval while retaining a single compact document map and native destination queries." No new experiment or new qualification paragraph is needed.

issues.location: paper/sections/experimental-setup.tex:69 and paper/sections/results.tex:53-87; paper/generated/trec_means.tex; PDF pp. 9, 11-12
issues.claim: Setup says "We report" both nDCG@10 and Recall@100, but the prospective results/table/figure display only nDCG.
evidence: The development table includes R@100, whereas neither Table 3 nor Fig. 4 reports TREC-COVID recall.
results/b2_review_20261101/evidence/results/b2_full_r1_20261031t064859/scoring/summary.json already contains every recall mean and nominal descriptive interval.
At 75% TREC coverage, MiniLM ARC2 Recall@100 is 0.09983604059514704 and native Full-Y is 0.10521378018323918; E5 ARC2 is 0.09966692928143464 and native Full-Y is 0.11624395516879528.
The corresponding MiniLM nDCG operating point is 0.5195 versus 0.5203. Thus closeness at top-10 and recall at 100 are different empirical statements.
issues.why_it_matters: A compact addition makes the near-native operating point precise and fulfills the announced two-metric reporting without weakening the nDCG-led contribution. This is an evidence-presentation gap, not a false nDCG claim.
issues.minimal_fix: Add a descriptive Recall@100 panel/companion table generated from the existing TREC means (all six methods, both migrations, all budgets). If space prevents this, add the 75% ARC2/native recall values in one sentence and explicitly point to a complete companion table in the packaged evidence. Keep recall descriptive; do not reuse the nDCG family labels.

issues.claim: The all-paid paragraph states family-supported wins/losses and an unresolved E5 change, while Table 4 shows only point means.
evidence: results/b1p_r5_review_20261027/scoring/results_summary.json contains the locked 32-contrast family and agrees with all stated decisions.
MiniLM ARC2 all-paid minus Procrustes all-paid: +0.03375954732030533, family interval [0.018645329403840227, 0.05040795355988812].
Table 3 already provides a useful significance-marker convention for the prospective family.
issues.why_it_matters: The strongest all-paid result is correct but less inspectable than the development and prospective claims. Readers must currently trust verbal interval decisions whose numeric evidence is absent.
issues.minimal_fix: Report MiniLM all-paid-minus-fixed as +0.0596 [0.0393, 0.0806], and add positive/negative/unresolved comparison markers to the all-paid baseline cells or a compact companion contrast table, using the existing 32-family intervals. Keep the current E5 negative/unresolved ordering visible; do not imply that Table 4 itself tests all possible comparisons.

issues.location: paper/sections/method.tex, Computation and Storage; paper/sections/experimental-setup.tex:41-42; Table 1; PDF pp. 7-8
issues.claim: Two solver backends are described but not explicitly assigned to the all-paid experiment.
evidence: Table 1 factors the dual m-by-m Gram matrix. The cost subsection identifies an equivalent primal backend that supports larger paired sets.
ops/b1p_stage.py:13 and :62 call tangent2_primal for ARC2; cpu_fit records BACKEND_ID in metadata at :78.
src/arc2_global/solver_backend.py identifies arc2_global_tangent2_primal_float64_r1 and retains the same initialization, target, lambda, intercept regularization and final float32 storage.

results/b1p_r5_review_20261027/scoring/cell_index.json explicitly marks the ten fixed1024 ARC2 cells as reused from B1-M and records backend_id=arc2_global_tangent2_primal_float64_r1 in the allpaid ARC2 fit receipts; ops/b1m_stage.py:29 calls the frozen dual fit_arc2_global.
issues.why_it_matters: A reader could apply the Table 1 dual recipe to 28,819 paid pairs without realizing which implementation produced Table 4. This is a reproducibility omission, not evidence of a changed scientific method.
issues.minimal_fix: Add one sentence after the all-paid setup: "All-paid ARC2 FiQA fits use the primal float64 backend described in Sect. 3.5, while fixed-anchor ARC2 comparisons reuse the locked dual-backend rankings; both implement the same frozen update rule."

issues.claim: Caption says all unmarked cells have intervals crossing zero; prose says Procrustes has a higher mean in all six cells even though the 75% MiniLM table rounds both means to 0.5195.
evidence: The unmarked ARC2 and native-reference rows are not baseline contrasts in the 30-family analysis, so no such family interval is assigned to them.
The raw ARC2-minus-Procrustes MiniLM/75% difference is -0.000023564924613148544, which disappears at the displayed four decimals.
All six raw Procrustes point differences are indeed negative, and all twelve Procrustes/LA2M family decisions are unresolved.
issues.why_it_matters: Both underlying findings are correct, but the literal caption over-scopes the intervals and the rounded table can appear to contradict the six-of-six sentence.
issues.minimal_fix: Change "Unmarked cells" to "Unmarked baseline cells". Change the prose to "Before rounding, Procrustes has higher point means in all six cells" or note that the MiniLM/75% difference is below 0.0001. No additional precision is needed elsewhere.

issues.claim: The first related-work paragraph repeats that the evaluated panel has five configurations and points to Sect. 4 twice.
evidence: Line 10: "HMoE provides related-work context; our evaluated panel comprises the five configurations specified in Sect. 4."
Line 13: "Our comparison instantiates five alignment and regression configurations under common paired-document supervision (Sect. 4)."
The same paragraph already contains the substantive geometric distinction and migration setting.
issues.why_it_matters: The duplicated panel disclaimer interrupts the novelty narrative and consumes space that could display existing recall or all-paid uncertainty evidence.
issues.minimal_fix: Delete line 13; retain the HMoE scope sentence and the contribution-led comparison of tangent targets with localized experts. Optionally combine the retained scope clause with the setup reference.

strongest_contribution_sentences: ARC2-Global fits two norm-scaled cosine-gradient corrections to a centered Procrustes initializer and folds them into one 1.13 MiB affine document adapter, preserving native destination queries without neural mapper training.

Across four development collections, two encoder migrations and three paid-document budgets, ARC2-Global achieves the highest macro nDCG@10 among six methods and improves on Procrustes by 0.0243, with family-adjusted interval [0.0181, 0.0308].
The second tangent correction adds 0.0069 macro development nDCG@10 beyond one correction, with family-adjusted interval [0.0038, 0.0100], while adding no inference stage.
On prospective TREC-COVID/E5, ARC2-Global improves nDCG@10 over the evaluated Converter by 0.2000-0.2572 and over affine ridge at every tested migration budget.

At the same 50% FiQA document budget, fitting all paid pairs raises MiniLM ARC2-Global nDCG@10 from 0.3075 to 0.3671, with an all-paid-minus-fixed gain of 0.0596 [0.0393, 0.0806], and supports gains over four of the five all-paid baselines.

supported_checks: All five development macro nDCG family intervals are positive.
Procrustes point means: 23/24 positive development differences; 0/6 positive TREC differences.
Prospective primary family: 11 positive, 19 unresolved, 0 negative intervals.
All-paid significance decisions and mixed-gallery diagnostic values agree with saved scoring JSON.
Coefficient count, MiB units and Converter parameter-storage ratio agree with implemented dimensions/architecture.
Method equations, raw affine initialization, norm factor, regularized intercept, two updates, normalization and tie order agree with inspected code.
verification.family_notes: Different development-baseline and mechanism-ablation intervals for the same point contrast reflect separately locked bootstrap analyses/families, not inconsistent point estimates.
verification.layout: Final PDF read in full as extracted text and all 15 pages visually inspected via rendered contact sheet; no clipping or missing table/figure detected.

scope_limits: Read paper/main.tex, every included section, all five generated TeX tables (including the two currently not included), the mechanism source, the current final PDF, saved raw-scored summaries/per-query arrays, mapper/backends and relevant scoring code.
No manuscript edits, qrel files opened, experiments, encoding, fitting, retrieval reruns, retuning, scientific-source changes, publication actions or child agents.

No prior review artifact, reviewer score or opinion was used to derive findings. The mandatory workspace AGENTS.md contained a historical review-status summary; that summary was not treated as review evidence.

This is an internal consistency and existing-evidence review. It does not independently establish literature novelty, verify all external-paper descriptions, audit every acquired vector byte, reproduce encoders or certify deployment cost.
